mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_rubrics ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, name, description, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING uuid, external_id

INSERT INTO evaluation_rubric_versions ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, rubric_uuid, version, body, pass_score, model, created_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.RubricUUID}, #{params.Version}, #{params.Body}, #{params.PassScore}, #{params.Model}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, rubric_uuid, version, body, pass_score, model, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, rubric_uuid, version, body, pass_score, model, created_at FROM evaluation_rubric_versions WHERE rubric_uuid = #{rubricUUID} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_tasks ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_user_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, name, mode, status, agent_external_id, agent_version, environment_external_id, dataset_external_id, dataset_version_external_id, rubric_external_id, rubric_version_external_id, pass_score, rubric_body, rubric_model, strategy, low_score_threshold, optimize_system, baseline_system, vault_ids, resources, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByUserUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Mode}, #{params.Status}, #{params.AgentExternalID}, #{params.AgentVersion}, #{params.EnvironmentExternalID}, #{params.DatasetExternalID}, #{params.DatasetVersionExternalID}, #{params.RubricExternalID}, #{params.RubricVersionExternalID}, #{params.PassScore}, #{params.RubricBody}, #{params.RubricModel}, #{params.Strategy}, #{params.LowScoreThreshold}, #{params.OptimizeSystem}, #{params.BaselineSystem}, CAST(#{params.VaultIDs} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Resources} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING

INSERT INTO evaluation_task_items ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, task_uuid, task_external_id, case_external_id, round, position, query, expected_answer, expected_tool_trace, acceptance, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.TaskUUID}, #{params.TaskExternalID}, #{params.CaseExternalID}, #{params.Round}, #{params.Position}, #{params.Query}, #{params.ExpectedAnswer}, CAST(#{params.ExpectedToolTrace} AS jsonb), #{params.Acceptance}, 'pending', #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING

INSERT INTO evaluation_task_scores ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, task_uuid, item_uuid, status, score, passed, explanation, dimensions, error_message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.TaskUUID}, #{params.ItemUUID}, #{params.Status}, #{params.Score}, #{params.Passed}, #{params.Explanation}, CAST(#{params.Dimensions} AS jsonb), #{params.ErrorMessage}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
